title: Practice 7: Short adjectives and what follows them

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Which fits? *Алексей Н. Толстой, «Гиперболоид инженера Гарина»*
exercises.ru: В эту минуту он не был похож на ___.
exercises.why: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively»: доволен, согласен, рад, знаком, занят, готов. — DLI, Lesson 57. From Алексей Н. Толстой, «Гиперболоид инженера Гарина».
